spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: label
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: A human-readable label for this ROI (e.g. 'animal 2 / left hemisphere').

spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: n_vertices
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: Number of polygon vertices. A simple polygon needs at least three; a closed-ring last-equals-first vertex is not required.

spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: vertices_x
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: Polygon x coordinates in COORD_SPACE, same length as vertices_y and equal to n_vertices. These are the values ndi.fun.doc.gene.fromGEFbyROI passed to inpolygon to decide which records entered the pyramid this ROI depends on.

spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: vertices_y
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: Polygon y coordinates in COORD_SPACE, same length as vertices_x and equal to n_vertices.

spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: coord_space
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: The coordinate system vertices_x and vertices_y live in. For a Stereo-seq .gef the default 'gef_base_pixel' is the same integer pixel grid ndr.format.stereoseq.readGEF returns in X,Y. Named rather than left implicit so a future ROI drawn on an image aligned to the pyramid (not the raw GEF) can be stored under a different space without rewriting the pyramid.

spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: coord_units
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: The units of vertices_x and vertices_y. 'pixel' when the coordinates are in base pixels of the referenced pyramid; a physical unit (e.g. 'micrometer') is also allowed and requires COORD_SPACE to name a physical space.

spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: n_records_in
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: Number of source records (spots) that fell inside this polygon when the pyramid was built. Zero is allowed and means the polygon was empty; the pyramid dependency may then be a dangling id, which is why that dependency is permitted.

spatialGeneExpressionROI.name: roi_format_version
spatialGeneExpressionROI.documentation: Version of the ROI representation. 1 is a simple closed polygon stored as parallel vertices_x and vertices_y vectors; future versions may add multi-polygon shapes or holes.
